title: Canonical - Vesting Start Transaction
description: Canonical (hypothetical OCF) representation of a vesting-start transaction. Anchors the vesting schedule of a security to a wall-clock date. The security's `VestingScheduleTemplate` reference lives on the issuance transaction; this transaction supplies only the per-security anchor date. One per security (per schedule, in a hypothetical future where a security could carry multiple schedules).

date.description: The vesting commencement date for the referenced security.

security_id.description: Identifier of the security whose vesting clock starts on `date`. The security's `vesting_template_id` is read from the issuance transaction; this transaction does not re-carry it.
